simple.summary: מִכְמְתָת (Mikmᵉthâth) means Mikmethath , a place in Palestine First listed occurrence: Josh 16 6.

definitions.full: H4366. Mikmethath מִכְמְתָת proper name, of a location always ׳הַמּ , Josh 16:6 ( ᵐ5 Ικασμων , ᵐ5 L εις Αχθωθ , A Μαχθωθ ), 17:7 ( ׳הַמּ מֵאָשֵׁר ; ᵐ5 Δηλαναθ , A ἀπὸ Ασερ Μαχθωθ , and similarly ᵐ5 L ), place in northeast Ephraim, near border of Manasseh, between Shechem and Taanath Shilo; Buhl Geogr. 109 conjecture khirbet kefr beita.
definitions.rootNote: apparently from an unused root meaning to hide; concealment;
